description: This source file defines extension methods for Memory<byte> and ReadOnlyMemory<byte> types to retrieve their underlying ArraySegment<byte> if available, throwing an exception otherwise.

classes.name: BufferExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for Memory<byte> and ReadOnlyMemory<byte> to access underlying array segments.

methods.name: GetArray (Memory<byte>)
methods.description: Returns the underlying ArraySegment<byte> of a Memory<byte> instance, delegating to the ReadOnlyMemory<byte> extension method.

methods.name: GetArray (ReadOnlyMemory<byte>)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the underlying array segment from ReadOnlyMemory<byte>; throws InvalidOperationException if not backed by an array.
